metadata.description: Original skills by sei-lit. Provider-agnostic: plain-Markdown skills usable from Claude Code, Codex, and other agents.

plugins.name: book-skills
plugins.description: Skills distilled from books: actionable procedures extracted from technical books, rewritten as review/decision checklists with attribution. First skill: good-code-review based on 'Good Code, Bad Code' by Tom Long.

plugins.name: skill-kit
plugins.description: Meta-plugin for growing an original skill collection: a new-skill scaffolding skill that generates provider-agnostic SKILL.md templates and keeps marketplace/plugin versions in sync.

plugins.name: pr-split
plugins.description: Split a finished feature branch into a tree of stacked PRs derived from the actual dependency graph. Bash engine (validate/apply/verify/prs) + a skill that designs the tree, gates PR creation on per-node verification, and reads per-repo knowledge from .pr-split/config.md.

plugins.name: model-strategy
plugins.description: Choose a cost-effective main model, effort, and bounded delegation plan for Claude Code or Codex. model-effort-guide skill + references, route-policy audit script, and Haiku/Sonnet/Opus/Fable agent definitions. Ported from 9uiLe/plugins model-strategy 0.5.0 (MIT); hooks are not bundled.
